text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Director Akikawa asks me to
attend a
banquet for those affiliated
with the racing world.
It's like a who's
who of big names here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like a fish out of water! Somewhat
on edge,
my eyes dart around the
venue, until...

text_block_list.name: Gorgeous Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! There's no mistaking it—you
must be...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Hello, ma'am. My name is Daiichi Ruby.
It's truly a
pleasure to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby—an Umamusume born to a

prestigious family known far and wide.
She must
be representing them here.

text_block_list.name: Mustachioed Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
Come now, there's no one in this room
who
doesn't know your name.
Admittedly, you may
find it unpleasant
that a nobody such as myself
seeks to
presume familiarity...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You are far too modest, Executive
Director. Was
it not your sportswear
company that designed the
Italian club
team's uniforms?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It's a pleasure to see you again. Allow
me to
extend my deepest gratitude to
your company for
the support you've
given my family since my
grandmother's
time as an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby navigates conversation with
these
industry giants with the utmost
ease. Her
composure is impeccable.

text_block_list.name: Older Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
I must say, you're the spitting image of
your
grandmother. Seeing you takes me
back to the
good old days...

text_block_list.name: Older Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
In particular, I'm reminded of the day
she
received her second URA Award.

text_block_list.name: Mustachioed Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
After that, your mother would go on to
achieve a
record-breaking victory in her
debut race. I was
on the very edge of my
seat! It was like witnessing
the second
coming of the legend!

text_block_list.name: Gorgeous Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed! She performed
spectacularly in the
Tiara tour as well.
The URA award could have
gone to no
one more fitting!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your high praise.
My
grandmother and mother are the
pride of my
family. I aspire to be like
them.

text_block_list.name: Older Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll be looking forward to
seeing you in
action! Your mother's
career was no less brilliant
than your
grandmother's, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mustachioed Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain you'll go on to have a
marvelous
career that exceeds even your
predecessors! I'll
be watching your
journey with bated breath!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I have a long way to go,
but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I will strive my utmost so as not to betray
your
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I plan on returning to the academy
after this.
Yes, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A little while later, I'm walking back to
the venue
from the bathroom when I
spot Daiichi Ruby
standing in the
corridor and talking on the phone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but recall how detached she
seemed
as everyone piled her with
expectations. Even
now, her impassive
expression has me a little
worried.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Pardon? Have I perhaps caused you
some
offence?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I awkwardly stumble through my
question, asking
her if she doesn't feel
pressured under the weight
of
everyone's expectations.
choice_data_list: そうじゃなくて、さっき……

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Your consideration is much appreciated.

However, their expectations are not for
me, but
for my family. I have no reason
to feel weighed
down by them.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please go ahead and return to the main

hall—don't mind me. As a Tracen trainer,
you
surely have better conversational
partners than
myself to choose from.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I see. In that case...
choice_data_list: 実は、挨拶する相手の顔がわからなくて……
choice_data_list_en: Actually, I don't know what the person I'm greeting looks like...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby talks me through a list of
people I
should speak with. Her
networking skills put mine
to
shame—and I'm an adult!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It was nothing. Now, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby walks back toward the hall
with
confident steps, cutting a dignified
figure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet, her small stature and the weight of

expectation on her shoulders give me an

impression of fragility that I can't seem
to shake.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Your consideration is much appreciated.

However, their expectations are not for
me, but
for my family. I have no reason
to feel weighed
down by them.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If I appeared in need of support to you,
it can
only be due to my own
inadequacy.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I apologize for worrying you.
Now, if
you'll excuse me.
choice_data_list: いや、そういうわけでは……！
choice_data_list_en: No, that's really not the case...!

with
confident steps, cutting a dignified
figure.

expectation on her shoulders give me an

impression of fragility that I can't seem
to shake.
